@deskKitUnknown.description: Tag on an address row when the address type is not recognised. One short word.

@deskKitRingCancelled.description: Screen-reader label of the progress ring on a cancelled transaction.

@deskKitRingConfirmed.description: Screen-reader label of the progress ring on a fully confirmed transaction.

deskKitRingProgress: {confirmations, plural, one{{confirmations} of {needed} confirmation} other{{confirmations} of {needed} confirmations}}

@deskKitRingProgress.description: Screen-reader label of the progress ring on a transaction still confirming, e.g. '2 of 3 confirmations'. {needed} is the number of confirmations the wallet waits for.

@deskKitHiddenAmount.description: Screen-reader label of an amount that is hidden behind dots (privacy mode).

@deskKitChooseFile.description: Button of a file drop zone: opens a file picker. Short.

deskKitNeedAction: {label}, {count, plural, one{{count} needs action} other{{count} need action}}

@deskKitNeedAction.description: Screen-reader label of a sidebar entry with a badge, e.g. 'Activity, 2 need action'. {label} is the entry's name.

@deskKitCloseEsc.description: Tooltip and screen-reader label of the close (X) button of a dialog or drawer; Esc is the keyboard key that does the same.

@deskKitOptional.description: Small grey note beside a form field's label: the field may stay empty. One short word.

@deskKitBackAlt.description: Tooltip of the back arrow at the top of a page; Alt+Left is the keyboard shortcut.

@deskKitStepOf.description: Small step counter above the title of an onboarding page on a narrow window, e.g. 'Step 2 of 4'.

@deskKitHeroCaptionEpicbox.description: Caption under the Epicbox picture on the Send page. Written in capitals; at most about 24 characters, it sits in a 160 px wide picture.

@deskKitHeroCaptionHttp.description: Caption under the HTTP picture on the Send page. Capitals; at most about 24 characters.

@deskKitHeroCaptionTor.description: Caption under the Tor picture on the Send page. Capitals; at most about 24 characters.

@deskKitHeroCaptionFile.description: Caption under the transaction-file picture on the Send page. Capitals; at most about 24 characters.

deskKitHeroLabelEpicbox: Epicbox: the payment goes to the Epicbox server, which holds it until the recipient’s wallet is back

@deskKitHeroLabelEpicbox.description: Screen-reader description of the Epicbox picture on the Send page.

deskKitHeroLabelHttp: Link · HTTP: the payment goes straight to the recipient’s wallet, which must be open

@deskKitHeroLabelHttp.description: Screen-reader description of the HTTP picture on the Send page.

deskKitHeroLabelTor: Link · Tor: the payment goes straight to the recipient’s wallet, routed through the Tor network

@deskKitHeroLabelTor.description: Screen-reader description of the Tor picture on the Send page.

deskKitHeroLabelFile: Direct · File Transfer: a transaction file is handed over, a response file comes back, then the sender finalizes

@deskKitHeroLabelFile.description: Screen-reader description of the transaction-file picture on the Send page.

@deskKitReachCheck.description: Small button of the internet-reachability notice in the HTTP receiving settings: check again. One word.

@deskKitReachChecking.description: Notice title while the app asks an outside service whether the HTTP port is reachable.

@deskKitReachNoIpTitle.description: Notice title when the app could not learn the computer's public IP address.

deskKitReachNoIpText: The internet could not be asked for it. Try again later.

@deskKitReachNoIpText.description: Notice text under 'Public IP not found'.

deskKitReachNoIpTextLan: The internet could not be asked for it. Try again later. On your network: {address}.

@deskKitReachNoIpTextLan.description: Same as the previous message, plus the computer's address on the local network.

@deskKitReachClosedTitle.description: Notice title when the HTTP port is not reachable from outside.

deskKitReachClosedText: Forward TCP port {port} on your router to this computer, then check again.

@deskKitReachClosedText.description: Notice text: the user must forward the port on their router.

deskKitReachClosedTextLan: Forward TCP port {port} on your router to this computer ({address}), then check again.

@deskKitReachClosedTextLan.description: Same, with the computer's address on the local network in brackets.

@deskKitReachUnknownTitle.description: Notice title when the port check service did not answer.

deskKitReachUnknownText: The port check did not answer. Try again later.
deskKitReachUnknownTextLan: The port check did not answer. Try again later. On your network: {address}.

@deskKitReachUnknownTextLan.description: Same, plus the computer's address on the local network.

@deskKitReachOpenTitle.description: Notice title when the HTTP port is reachable from outside.

@deskKitReachOpenText.description: Notice text under 'Reachable from the internet'.

deskKitReachOpenTextLan: Port {port} is forwarded. On your network: {address}.

@deskKitReachOpenTextLan.description: Same, plus the computer's address on the local network.

deskKitAgeSeconds: {count, plural, one{{count} s ago} other{{count} s ago}}

@deskKitAgeSeconds.description: How long ago something happened, in seconds, e.g. '40 s ago'. Abbreviate the unit.

deskKitAgeMinutes: {count, plural, one{{count} min ago} other{{count} min ago}}

@deskKitAgeMinutes.description: How long ago something happened, in minutes, e.g. '2 min ago'. Abbreviate the unit.

deskKitAgeHours: {count, plural, one{{count} h ago} other{{count} h ago}}

@deskKitAgeHours.description: How long ago something happened, in hours, e.g. '3 h ago'. Abbreviate the unit.

deskKitAgeDays: {count, plural, one{{count} d ago} other{{count} d ago}}

@deskKitAgeDays.description: How long ago something happened, in days, e.g. '2 d ago'. Abbreviate the unit.

@deskKitNodeBefore410.description: Small note under 'Accepts transactions' when the node runs a version older than 4.1.0 that cannot tell. Lowercase, short.

@deskKitNodeNoAnswer.description: Small note under a node fact when the node did not answer. Lowercase, short.

@deskKitNodesDisagree.description: Part of the network line of the node card: the public nodes report different latest blocks.

@deskKitNodesAgree.description: Part of the network line of the node card: all nodes agree on this block height. {height} is a number with thousands separators.

deskKitNodesUp: {up, plural, one{{up} of {total} node up} other{{up} of {total} nodes up}}

@deskKitNodesUp.description: Part of the network line of the node card, e.g. '5 of 6 nodes up'.

deskKitEpicboxUp: {up, plural, one{{up} of {total} Epicbox server up} other{{up} of {total} Epicbox servers up}}

@deskKitEpicboxUp.description: Part of the network line of the node card, e.g. '3 of 4 Epicbox servers up'.

@deskKitLastBlock.description: Part of the network line of the node card and a note under Height: how long ago the last block was found. {age} is e.g. '2 min ago'.

deskKitLimitedNetwork: {site} is not reachable; the facts come from the node only.

@deskKitLimitedNetwork.description: Line on the node card when the status website cannot be reached and only the node itself answered.

@deskKitFactHeight.description: Label of a fact on the node card: the node's block height. One short word.

@deskKitFactVersion.description: Label of a fact on the node card: the node's software version. One short word.

@deskKitFactAccepts.description: Label of a fact on the node card: whether the node is ready to take new transactions. Narrow: at most about 22 characters.

@deskKitFactYes.description: Value of the 'Accepts transactions' fact. One short word.

@deskKitFactNotYet.description: Value of the 'Accepts transactions' fact: the node is not ready yet. Short.

@deskKitFactUnknown.description: Value of the 'Accepts transactions' fact when it could not be learned. One short word.

@deskKitFactLatency.description: Label of a fact on the node card: the time the node takes to answer. One short word.

@deskKitFactUptime.description: Label of a fact on the node card: how much of the time the node was up. One short word.

@deskKitFactPeers.description: Label of a fact on the node card: the number of other nodes it is connected to. One short word.

@deskKitFactOperator.description: Label of a fact on the node card: who runs the node. One short word.

@deskKitAtTip.description: Small note under Height: the node is on the latest block. Lowercase, short.

@deskKitBehind.description: Small note under Height: the node is this many blocks behind. {blocks} is the number with thousands separators; {count} is the same number for grammar.

@deskKitVersionOut.description: Small note under Version: a newer version is released. {version} is the version number.

@deskKitVersionLatest.description: Small note under Version: the node runs the newest version. Lowercase, short.

@deskKitUptimeWindow.description: Small note under Uptime: the figure covers the last 24 hours. Short.

@deskKitAtTime.description: Small note under Peers on a down node: the time it was last seen, e.g. 'at 14:05'.

@deskKitListedOfficial.description: Small note under Operator: the node is on the official list. Lowercase, short.

@deskKitSourceChecked.description: Source line of the node card: the status site and when it was last asked. {time} is e.g. 14:05.

@deskKitLatencyMeasured.description: Source line of the node card. {where} is 'from this computer', 'over Tor' or 'from the status site'.

@deskKitSiteLastReached.description: Source line of the node card when the status site is not reachable now. {time} is e.g. 14:05.

@deskKitSince.description: Part of the node card's header when the node is down: since when, e.g. 'since 14:05'.

@deskKitNodeSemantics.description: Screen-reader label of the node card. {status} is a status word such as Synced.

@deskKitNodeDownTitle.description: Title of the notice on the node card when the node does not answer.

deskKitNodeDownText: Switch to {host}, the healthiest other node?

@deskKitNodeDownText.description: Text of the notice on the node card offering to use another node. {host} is a host name.

@deskKitSwitch.description: Button of the node-down notice: switch to the suggested node. One word.

@deskKitLimitedInfo.description: Small warning tag on the node card: only some facts are known.

@deskKitFromStatusSite.description: Small note under Latency: measured by the status website.

@deskKitOverTor.description: Small note under Latency: measured through Tor.

@deskKitFromThisComputer.description: Small note under Latency: measured from this computer.

@deskKitNodeUse.description: Screen-reader label of a node row in the node list: pick this node.

@deskKitNodeUseOperator.description: Screen-reader label of a node row: pick this node; {operator} is who runs it.

@deskKitNodeUseDown.description: Screen-reader label of a node row whose node does not answer.

@deskKitNodeUseOperatorDown.description: Screen-reader label of a node row whose node does not answer; {operator} is who runs it.

@deskKitLocalNodeUse.description: Screen-reader label of the 'Local node' row of the node list. {state} is its state, e.g. Synced.

@deskKitMethodWaitingTor.description: Bold status word of the Epicbox line (Receive, Settings › Receiving): waits until Tor is connected.

@deskKitMethodOn.description: Bold status word of a receiving method line: working. One short word.

@deskKitMethodOverTor.description: Detail of the Epicbox status line: the connection goes through Tor. {host} is the Epicbox server.

@deskKitMethodOff.description: Bold status word of a receiving method line: turned off. One short word.

deskKitMethodEpicboxOffDetail: Payments to this address wait on the Epicbox server.

@deskKitMethodEpicboxOffDetail.description: Detail of the Epicbox status line when Epicbox is off.

@deskKitMethodConnecting.description: Bold status word of the Epicbox status line: connecting.

@deskKitMethodSlow.description: Bold status word of the Epicbox status line: the server answers slowly.

@deskKitMethodNotAnswering.description: Bold status word of the Epicbox status line: the server does not answer.

deskKitMethodEpicboxDown: {host}. Payments wait on the Epicbox server.

@deskKitMethodEpicboxDown.description: Detail of the Epicbox status line when the server does not answer. {host} is the Epicbox server.

deskKitMethodHttpOffDetail: Straight from another wallet while this one is open.

@deskKitMethodHttpOffDetail.description: Detail of the HTTP status line when HTTP is off: how HTTP payments work.

@deskKitMethodStarting.description: Bold status word of the HTTP status line: the listener is starting.

@deskKitMethodHttpInternet.description: Detail of the HTTP status line: reachable from the internet on this port.

@deskKitMethodHttpLocal.description: Detail of the HTTP status line: reachable from this computer only. Keep the address 127.0.0.1.

@deskKitMethodNotReceiving.description: Bold status word of the HTTP status line: the listener failed.

deskKitMethodPortInUse: Port {port} is in use by another program. Close it, or change the port below.

@deskKitMethodPortInUse.description: Detail of the HTTP status line when the port is taken.

@deskKitMethodNotInBuild.description: Bold status word of the Tor status line when this build has no Tor.

deskKitMethodTorOffDetail: Slower and more private. Blocked or not allowed in some countries.

@deskKitMethodTorOffDetail.description: Detail of the Tor status line when Tor is off: what Tor means for the user.

@deskKitMethodTorPublishing.description: Bold status word of the Tor status line: Tor is up and the address is being published.

@deskKitMethodTorConnecting.description: Bold status word of the Tor status line while Tor connects; the detail is a percentage.

@deskKitMethodTorOnDetail.description: Detail of the Tor status line when Tor works.

@deskKitMethodTorNotPublished.description: Bold status word of the Tor status line: Tor runs but the receiving address is not published yet.

@deskKitMethodTorSendsWork.description: Detail of the Tor status line: {reason} is a short reason; sending still works.

deskKitMethodTorNotReachableYet: The Tor address is not reachable yet

@deskKitMethodTorNotReachableYet.description: Default reason inside the Tor status line when the core gave none.

@deskKitMethodTorStopped.description: Bold status word of the Tor status line: Tor stopped.

@deskKitMethodTorStoppedDetail.description: Detail of the Tor status line when Tor stopped and the core gave no reason.

@deskKitMethodFiles.description: Bold status word of the transaction-file method line (no state).

@deskKitChipOverTor.description: Small chip on the Send and Receive pages: this method goes through Tor. Narrow chip: 2 short words.

@deskKitChipStarting.description: Small chip: Tor is still starting. Narrow chip.

@deskKitChipNotConnected.description: Small chip: Tor should be used but is not connected. Narrow chip.

@deskKitChipNotOverTor.description: Small chip: this method does not go through Tor. Narrow chip.

deskKitPasswordNote: Estimated on this device from the length and from common words, names and patterns, for an attacker with fast hardware trying 100,000 guesses a second against this wallet’s file. A guide, not a guarantee.

@deskKitPasswordNote.description: Tooltip behind the info icon under a new-password field: how the 'time to crack' is estimated.

@deskKitPasswordNoteLabel.description: Screen-reader name of the info icon under a new-password field.

@deskKitInfoLabel.description: Screen-reader name of an info icon that opens an explanation popover and has no title of its own.

@deskKitNotCopied.description: Brief label of a copy button when the clipboard refused the text. Short.

@deskKitCopied.description: Brief label of a copy button for 1.5 seconds after a successful copy. Short.

@deskKitQrOf.description: Caption and screen-reader label of a QR code. {title} is the name of what it holds, e.g. 'Epicbox address' (lowercase in the sentence).

@deskKitQrOfTag.description: Screen-reader label of a QR code with a note. {title} is the name of what it holds; {tag} a short lowercase note.

@deskKitQrShowOf.description: Screen-reader label of the button that reveals a QR code. {title} is what it holds.

@deskKitQrShow.description: Button and tooltip: reveal the hidden QR code. Short.

@deskKitQrHide.description: Button and tooltip: hide the QR code again. Short.

@deskKitQrHideCode.description: Screen-reader label of the button that hides the QR code.

@deskKitMethodConnected.description: State word of the Epicbox method line on Receive and in Settings when the server answers: "Connected · host".

@deskKitReachTorOff.description: Notice in the Link · HTTP guide when the status server cannot check the port over Tor. Short, impersonal.
